summary: Iteration 74 — launch-readiness bug list (11 items) verification on the preview env. All 11 confirmed fixes verified end-to-end: intelligence briefing no longer hangs (30s window, falls back to stale cache when LLM slow); Explorer CTA on /pricing renders 'Start free' with no spinner and is clickable; the two other tier CTAs render their labels; mentor (Solon) is now grounded in the live catalog (system prompt injects real titles and hard-forbids invention — verified by backend SSE test that all cited titles are verbatim catalog titles); Terms/Disclaimer/Compliance/Privacy pages have zero unfilled template tokens, correct entity 'ITHR Technologies Consulting LLC', domain ithr.online, and DRAFT notice preserved; /privacy renders a real Privacy Policy (GDPR + UAE PDPL sections); footer 'Privacy Policy' link (data-testid=footer-privacy) routes to /privacy; catalog search (?q=) narrows to Prompt Engineering Mastery and Retrieval-Augmented Generation for the Enterprise; /nonexistent-page-xyz-123 renders the NotFound page with 404 and home link; /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml are served as real plain-text/XML (not the React shell); no user-facing 'ithr.tech', 'learn.ithr.tech', or 'FZ-LLC' present in scanned surface; mentor 'Past Conversations' shows the new thread exactly ONCE (idempotent upsert working — no duplicate). Backend pytest: 12/12 PASSED (test_iteration74_launch_readiness.py). Frontend Playwright: 5/5 flows green (pricing CTAs, 404, privacy, legal pages, catalog search, intelligence, mentor).

integration_issues.issue: Requirement states 'Clicking it should navigate to the register/signup route' — actual behaviour is to first route anonymous clicks to /login (with state.from=/pricing). From /login the 'Create an account' link takes the user to /register. This is a reasonable UX (login-first for existing users) but IS a mild deviation from the stated requirement. The register route is reached in 2 clicks, not 1. Non-blocking; behaviour is documented in Pricing.jsx handleCheckout: if (!user) navigate('/login').

action_items: OPTIONAL: If product wants a truly one-click Start-free flow for the Explorer tier, update Pricing.jsx handleCheckout to navigate directly to /register (currently /login when packageId is null AND user is anonymous). Backend and UI otherwise fully green.

OPTIONAL: On /intelligence, when the live-generation call falls back to a cached briefing served with stale=true / cache_age_hours=999, the UI shows 'CACHED · 999H AGO' — cosmetic but confusing. Consider clamping the label to 'stale' or 'cached (retry)' when stale=true is set.
critical_code_review_comments: intelligence_router.py L34-51: asyncio.wait_for(...) around generate_intelligence_briefing with 18s ceiling — sound. Timeout branch returns stale cache with a stale=true flag AND age=999 as a sentinel; consider returning HTTP 200 with an explicit 'stale' field only (avoid the 999 magic number).

mentor_router.py _build_catalog_block(): injects live catalog into the system prompt with clear 'exact titles only' instruction. Solid grounding. Note: sort by title, category included, slug included — helps the model disambiguate. Verified by backend test — Solon returned only verbatim catalog titles.

mentor_router.py _persist_mentor_turn(): now a SINGLE idempotent upsert keyed by session id ($setOnInsert for id/title/created_at, $push for messages). This is the fix for the duplicate-thread bug — confirmed working in the browser (Past Conversations shows exactly 1 entry for a brand-new session).

LegalDoc.jsx: PLACEHOLDER regex is now \{\{\s*([A-Z0-9_]+)\s*\}\} — matches only KNOWN uppercase tokens. If counsel adds a lower-case placeholder or a template variable with different casing, it will be silently left as-is (won't render). Current markdown corpus is 100% uppercase tokens so this is safe today, but consider a build-time lint that fails when any un-mapped {{ ... }} token is discovered in /public/legal/*.md.

Pricing.jsx L211-222: disabled predicate is `!!p.packageId && processingId === p.packageId` — because Explorer's packageId is null, `!!null === false` short-circuits and disabled stays false even while processingId is also null. This is the correct fix for the original 'null === null' loading-spinner bug. Verified in the browser.

public/robots.txt L13: Sitemap URL is https://ithr.online/sitemap.xml (production domain hardcoded). On preview this is served as-is so any external crawler that hits the preview robots.txt will be pointed at the production sitemap. Fine for production, mildly misleading on preview — not a blocker.
